_meta.description: Two-sample z-test on revenue by treatment arm (TEST_Z_TWO_SAMPLE, the large-sample normal sibling of TEST_T / TEST_WELCH) beside TEST_WELCH on the same split: the statistic is the same and the p-values differ only in the tail (normal against Student's t), so at 400 rows they nearly agree. Its p-value matches OVERLAY_Z_CELL / OVERLAY_Z_VS_REF for the same mean, variance and n.
